name: Tyk API Management Platform
description_en:
Tyk is an API gateway and management platform. Gateway handles traffic and policy enforcement; Dashboard manages APIs and access; Developer Portal organizes API discovery and subscriptions; Pump exports analytics. Cloud, hybrid and self-managed arrangements place these responsibilities in different environments.

The free open-source Gateway is not the whole commercial platform. This profile concentrates on API routing, policies, rate limits and deployment boundaries. The current site also promotes AI/MCP capabilities, whose exact version and subscription entitlement should be checked separately.
description_zh:
Tyk 是 API 网关与管理平台。Gateway 处理流量及策略，Dashboard 管理 API 和访问，Developer Portal 组织发现及订阅，Pump 导出分析。云、混合、自运维方案将这些责任放在不同环境。

免费开源 Gateway 不是完整商业平台。本文聚焦 API 路由、策略、限流及部署边界；当前网站也推广 AI／MCP，具体版本及订阅权限应另核。

sections.title_en: Manage the public API path and its upstream together
sections.title_zh: 一起管理公开 API 路径及上游
sections.en: A proposed trial could expose a read-only order endpoint, create a policy/key and compare valid, missing and invalid credentials. The API listen path and target URL determine routing; optional middleware can transform requests and responses. The tutorial also demonstrates cached responses with X-Tyk-Cached-Response. Check that a cached read is acceptable and that authentication and allowed methods match the backend contract. This is an evaluation suggestion, not a request executed here.
sections.zh: 建议试验公开一个只读订单端点、创建策略／密钥，比较有效、缺失、无效凭据。API 监听路径及目标地址决定路由，可选中间件转换请求响应。教程还演示 X-Tyk-Cached-Response 缓存响应。应确认缓存读取可接受，认证及允许方法符合后端契约。本例为评估建议，本次未发请求。

sections.title_en: Middleware settings can change the rest of the API
sections.title_zh: 中间件设置可能影响其余 API
sections.en: Enabling an endpoint allowlist blocks the rest of the API except endpoints explicitly allowed; it is not merely an annotation on one route. Ignore Authentication deliberately skips authentication on an endpoint. Request validation differs between OAS and Classic definitions: the guide describes headers/body for OAS and body-only for Classic. Test rejected paths and unintended methods alongside the happy path. A gateway setting does not stop consumers bypassing it through an independently reachable backend.
sections.zh: 启用端点允许列表后，其余未明确允许端点会被阻止，并非仅给一路径加注释。Ignore Authentication 则有意跳过端点认证。请求校验也区分 OAS 与 Classic：指南描述前者校验请求头／正文，后者仅正文。除成功路径外需测试被拒路径及意外方法；若消费者能独立直达后端，网关设置无法防止绕过。

sections.title_en: Distributed rate limiting assumes traffic distribution
sections.title_zh: 分布式限流依赖流量分布
sections.en: The Distributed Rate Limiter divides allowance among gateways. The guide warns that uneven load balancing at low rates can produce false positives. Redis-based alternatives and a threshold-based fallback change the tradeoff. Custom rate-limit keys depend on required credential metadata; an empty evaluated key falls back to credential-ID limiting. If a shared organization allowance is intended, missing metadata can therefore change the effective grouping. Evaluate uneven traffic and absent metadata before treating a configuration as an exact global commercial quota.
sections.zh: Distributed Rate Limiter 将额度分给各网关；指南警告低速率下负载不均会产生误限。Redis 替代方案及阈值回退改变权衡。自定义限流键依赖所需凭据元数据，计算结果为空时回退到凭据 ID。若原意是组织共享额度，缺失元数据就可能改变实际分组。将配置作为准确全局商业额度前，应测试不均流量及缺失元数据。

sections.title_en: Timeouts and circuit breakers are optional policies
sections.title_zh: 超时及熔断是可选策略
sections.en: The transformation guide describes endpoint timeouts and circuit breakers to limit waiting and repeated upstream failure. Their presence in the product does not show they are enabled or tuned for a particular API. Start with a deliberately slow disposable backend and inspect client status, logs and possible prior side effects; gateway cancellation is not evidence that the backend transaction was undone. Exact retry/status behavior for the selected release and topology was not verified here.
sections.zh: 转换指南描述端点超时及熔断，用于限制等待及反复上游失败。产品具备这些能力不代表具体 API 已启用、调好。可用有意缓慢的可丢弃后端检查客户端状态、日志及此前副作用；网关取消不能证明后端事务已撤销。本次未核实所选版本、拓扑的具体重试／状态行为。

sections.title_en: The full demo includes operational dependencies
sections.title_zh: 完整演示包含运维依赖
sections.en: The self-managed quickstart includes Gateway, Dashboard, Portal, Redis, PostgreSQL, Pump and sample services. Pump moves analytics written through Redis to reporting storage. A working sample is not a production topology or backup plan. Confirm persistence, component compatibility, upgrades and recovery before real traffic. Cloud manages infrastructure; hybrid keeps customer data planes with a managed control plane; self-management leaves the runtime and stores with the operator. No container or service was started during this research.
sections.zh: 自运维 Quickstart 含 Gateway、Dashboard、Portal、Redis、PostgreSQL、Pump 及示例服务，Pump 将经 Redis 写入的分析搬到报告存储。示例可运行不等于生产拓扑或备份计划，接真实流量前需核对持久化、组件兼容、升级及恢复。云方案管理基础设施，混合方案将客户数据面配托管控制面，自运维则由运营方负责运行与存储。本次未启动容器或服务。

sections.title_en: Free Gateway and paid management have distinct licenses
sections.title_zh: 免费 Gateway 与付费管理许可不同
sections.en: Official documentation distinguishes open-source Gateway/Pump and other components from proprietary Dashboard, Developer Portal and other platform parts. Its licensing guide identifies MPL 2.0 for listed open components and license keys for proprietary on-premises components. A self-managed trial of the whole stack does not grant perpetual use of all of it. Because the catalog entry is the complete platform, its open-source boolean remains unknown rather than applying the Gateway license to everything; verify current component and purchase terms.
sections.zh: 官方区分开源 Gateway／Pump 等组件与专有 Dashboard、Developer Portal 及其他平台部分，许可指南为所列开源组件标 MPL 2.0，专有本地组件需许可密钥。完整栈自运维试用不授予所有部分永久使用。目录对象为完整平台，因此整体开源布尔保持未知，不将 Gateway 许可套给全部产品；仍需核对当前组件及采购条款。

sections.title_en: Choose consumption pricing or a flat contract
sections.title_zh: 选择用量计价或固定合同
sections.en: Core is consumption-based; Professional is described as flat rate with unlimited API services/requests; Enterprise is custom for more complex needs. All three support cloud, hybrid and self-managed modes, but no numeric subscription quote was shown. Confirm the metered unit, commitment, add-ons and infrastructure costs before comparing plans. The free OSS gateway is separate from the 48-hour full-featured Cloud trial. The deployment guide’s general no-usage-limits wording should not erase Core’s current consumption model.
sections.zh: Core 按消费计价，Professional 描述为固定价、API 服务／请求不限，Enterprise 为复杂需求定制。三层均支持云、混合、自运维，但未展示数字报价。比较前需确认计量单位、承诺、附加项及基础设施成本。免费开源网关与四十八小时全功能云试用分别存在；部署指南概括“不限用量”不能抹去当前 Core 消费模式。
